title: Cohomology comparison for ordinary pullbacks of the specified affine Cech model
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U\subseteq T$ an affine open and $V:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to (f^{-1}U).\mathrm{Opens}$ a covering by affine opens. Put $p=f|_U$ and $G=F|_{f^{-1}U}$. For every cartesian square with base map $g:T^{\prime}\to U$, projection $g^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to X$ and $f^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to T^{\prime}$, assuming injective resolutions in $X^{\prime}.\mathrm{Modules}$, and every $q\in\mathbb N$, there is an isomorphism $H^q(g^*C(p,G,V))\cong R^qf^{\prime}_*(g^{\prime})^*F$ of $\mathcal O_{T^{\prime}}$-modules, where the explicit complex is [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model]. No relative flatness is assumed; tensor is applied to the complex before taking homology.

proof.text: On an affine open W of the new base, the base changes of the affine cover members and their nonempty intersections are affine, by separatedness over the affine U. Affine pullback of quasi-coherent sections identifies the new section module with Gamma(W,O) tensor over Gamma(U,O) the old one. The pure-tensor formula commutes with face restrictions; finite products commute with tensor. The canonical base chart and GammaSpecIso identify the scalar actions in the specified model, yielding an isomorphism of ordinary alternating complexes. No tensor-homology interchange is used.

Affine acyclicity and the Cech comparison identify the homology of the new cover complex with cohomology of the pulled-back coefficient. Increasing-tuple restriction gives the same cohomology. The affine-base higher-direct-image comparison identifies it with sections of R^q fprime_* gprime^*F on W. These maps are induced by the Cech augmentation, hence commute with affine restrictions and glue to a sheaf isomorphism. Transport along the unique isomorphism from the supplied cartesian square to the standard pullback. The empty cover forces an empty source; all section complexes and higher direct images are then zero.

theorem finiteAffineCechModel_comparison {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {r : ℕ}
    (V : Fin r → (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    (hcover : iSup V = ⊤) :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
      [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ,
      Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
          (finiteAffineCechModel (f ∣_ U) (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι) V)).homology q ≅
        (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))
